text: Regret is an often painful emotion experienced upon the realisation that a different decision would have led to a better outcome. As regret related to poor real world financial decision making has been neglected, here we examine whether people with debt problems regret the financial decisions that led to those problems, whether their explanations for their debt problems are associated with what they regret, and relations between regret, explanations for indebtedness, and well-being.
source_label: Debt-related regret and well-being in people resolving problem debts
